projects.title: NeonPong
projects.description: Developed a real-time multiplayer Pong game with user authentication, chat, and matchmaking. Built the frontend with React + Tailwind, and the backend with Fastify + WebSockets, ensuring responsive UI and low-latency gameplay. Collaborated in a team environment using Git and Agile practices.

projects.title: Inception
projects.type: Docker virtualized infrastructure with multiple services
projects.description: A Docker-based multi-service infrastructure project. It includes NGINX with SSL, WordPress with MariaDB, Redis for caching, an FTP server, a static website, Adminer for DB management, and Portainer for container orchestration, all managed via Docker Compose.

projects.title: Web-Server
projects.description: Built a simple HTTP server from scratch to handle HTTP requests and responses. Focused on socket programming, multi-threading, and web protocols to create an efficient, scalable server architecture.

projects.title: Minishell
projects.description: Developed a custom shell that replicates essential Unix shell functionality, including command parsing, piping, and redirection. Focused on system calls, process management, and environment variable handling.
